nontrivial_switching_coset.method: exact E6 rank-six root-sum dynamic program; opposite root orientations identified

covering_radius.lower_proof: g(x)=x+sigma makes the two switching-class distances equal; exact rational LDL gives 3 A_x+19I positive definite, hence lambda_min(A_x)>-19/3 and the weighted-MaxCut spectral bound gives integer distance at least 124.
covering_radius.upper_proof: d(K^perp)=3 gives orthogonal-array strength two for every coset. Distances to K have mean 180 and variance 90; therefore not all can be at least 180, so every coset has a representative at distance at most 179.

theorem: The entire non-cut E6 switching coset has an exact 40-weight enumerator from 120 through 198. The full K enumerator and exact covering radius do not collapse to the same rank-six statistic; rigorous covering bounds are 124 <= rho(K) <= 179.
boundary: Pass4859 does not claim the ordinary cut-space Ising polynomial or exact covering radius. Those remain genuine hard finite problems; the signed-coset enumerator and radius bounds are exact.
